title: Tanker hit by unknown projectile in Strait of Hormuz
excerpt: A Kuwaiti-flagged tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, starting a fire, as Houthis claimed attacks on Saudi tankers.
x_post: A Kuwaiti-flagged tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, starting a fire. Houthis claimed attacks on two Saudi tankers. #MaritimeSecurity #StraitOfHormuz #Tanker #UKMTO
